answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence is proportional to held assets. Agents must lock capital, creating an opal barrier to entry that prevents identity forgery. By anchoring power to economic scarcity rather than an ivory tower of anonymity, the protocol forces an attacker to purchase a summit of tokens, making the cost of spinning up millions of malicious nodes prohibitively expensive and economically irrational compared to the network's total staked value.
